description: Resolve a token symbol or name to its address and decimals — call this FIRST when the user names a token; every other tool takes addresses. Results carry volume30dUsd, which disambiguates same-symbol tokens: the real one has volume. Empty search returns the top tokens by 30-day volume.

search.description: symbol or name fragment (e.g. "USDG"), or an exact 0x address

name: search_tokens
